title: Blocks: disclosure decision; drop Bloom/Merkle
description: 08-social-graph. NEEDS DECISION: does a blocked user learn of the block? Spec says never (08:9) but blocked-user code, blockedIdentity, BlockNotification disclose it. Bloom filter adds nothing over local lookup and leaks when shared (enumerable identities); Merkle non-membership proof leaks neighbors. Recommend removing both. Also follow-list privacy interaction with followers-only replies (agora C6) - NEEDS DECISION.
